settings.question: Do my feet need to be wet or dry before using?
settings.answer: Dry. The Lumière Sole Wand is designed for use on dry skin — no soaking or pre-treatment required. This makes it faster and more convenient than traditional foot baths.

settings.question: Will it hurt or damage my skin?
settings.answer: Not at all. The precision-engineered grinding head is calibrated to remove only dead, hardened skin — it stops naturally at the healthy skin layer, so there's no risk of irritation or over-exfoliation.

settings.question: How long does one session take?
settings.answer: Most people see full results in 3–5 minutes per foot. For heavily calloused areas, you may want a second pass — but the transformation is visible from session one.

settings.question: How often should I use it?
settings.answer: For best results, use 2–3 times per week initially to remove built-up skin. Once your feet are smooth, once a week is sufficient for maintenance.

settings.question: Is it suitable for all skin types?
settings.answer: Yes. The gentle yet effective action is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. If you have diabetes or circulation issues, consult your doctor before use.

settings.question: What batteries does it take?
settings.answer: The Lumière Sole Wand runs on standard AA batteries (included). Battery life is excellent — most customers report months of regular use before needing a replacement.

settings.question: Can I replace the grinding head?
settings.answer: Yes. The grinding head is detachable and fully replaceable. Replacement heads are available separately, ensuring your wand performs like new indefinitely.

settings.question: How do I clean it?
settings.answer: Simply detach the grinding head and rinse under warm water. Allow to air dry completely before reattaching. Do not submerge the main body of the device.

settings.question: Is this the same quality as a professional pedicure tool?
settings.answer: Many of our customers say it outperforms their salon tools at a fraction of the cost. The rotating mechanism delivers consistent, controlled exfoliation that manual tools simply can't replicate.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a full 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not completely satisfied with your results, contact us and we'll arrange a full refund — no questions asked.
